name: BookCompanion
description: Help with a book the user is reading: its story, chapters, characters or ideas, and where they are in it. Not for posters, flyers, signs or labels on things (those are about the thing).
examples: What does this chapter say about memory?
note: Foundational MOD defined as a spec (modos-system-design.md 5.3): the system can choose it and its text answers; its selectors and representations are not implemented yet.

default.label: Notes beside the book
default.description: Help with a book or document the user is reading: explain, summarize or look up what is in it.
